reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, post-fix stale re-review batch 1, 2026-08-02

samples_reviewed.question_text: The dot is at 20 and it moves forward 20 numbers. Starting from 20, just count up 20 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?
The two parts are 6 and 10. What is the sum?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency names three specific properties (zero-identity, order-changing, grouping-changing), but items like "What is 10 + 12?" (42) and "24 + 15 = ___" (45) are plain addition facts with no side-by-side reordering or regrouping shown, so no property is actually illustrated by most of the packet.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Of the three named sub-cases, only the zero-identity property appears, via seed 44's "0 + 22 = ___", seed 50's "Show 16 + 0 on the number line.", and seed 75's "0 + 44 = 54. True or False?"; the order-changing (commutative) and grouping-changing (associative) sub-cases never appear in any of the ten samples.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Numbers stay small and single-step throughout, e.g. "4 + 15 = ___" and "The two parts are 6 and 10. What is the sum?", fitting Grade 2 Q1 arithmetic demand regardless of the property-illustration gap noted elsewhere.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Formats vary (mcq, cloze, number-line, read_fill_in_blank, true_false, error_detect) but every variant renders a generic addition fact; the order-changing and grouping-changing contextual variants this competency specifically names are absent from all ten seeds.

competency_alignment.rationale: Seeds like 42's "What is 10 + 12?" and 82's "Dante says: 11 + 20 = 31. Is Dante correct?" vary only the numbers being added, not the order or grouping of addends, so the sampled variation builds generic addition fluency rather than the properties-of-addition skill this node names.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The competency states sums up to 1000, but the largest value shown across all ten samples is 40 (seed 51, counting up 20 from 20); nothing approaches even the low hundreds, let alone the stated 1000 ceiling.
